subject: Krasicki Estate Longcase - Restoration Update
snippet: Confirming target delivery of 26 October and the agreed parts budget of PLN 2,800.
body:
Dear Krasicki family,

Thank you for entrusting Woodard Horology with the 1820s estate longcase. I am writing to confirm the restoration is progressing on schedule toward our target delivery of 26 October 2026. The agreed parts budget remains PLN 2,800; the mainspring, escapement wheel and click spring have been ordered through my supplier in Biel.

Warm regards,
Jacob Woodard
Woodard Horology

subject: Order SM-KR-2026-042 - Krasicki parts

body:

body:

Best,
Stefan Müller
